design_notes.text: Current listings are not WordPress content: /net-lease-properties/ renders an empty #buildout div filled by BuildOut.embed (plugin inventory, token 8c286e4a...). 77 for-sale listings on 2026-11-01. 78 older WP 'property' pages remain published and crawlable.
Self-hosted commercial fonts: Futura PT (body/headings), Tungsten condensed (numerals), DearJoe 4 script accents; primary accent #43AFEB on near-black #1D1F27.
Stats claims are inconsistent across pages ($9+B vs $9.3B vs 'Five billion'; 4,000+ vs 4,500 transactions) and footer copyright is stale (2024); owner must confirm before reuse.

Duplicate URLs serve identical pages (about-us = real-estate-acquisition-disposition, our-agents = net-lease-advisors, testimonials = real-estate-testimonials, properties = net-lease-properties, recently-closed = real-estate-investment-sales, list-with-us = net-lease-real-estate, careers = commercial-real-estate-careers, home = /home/).
